sentence_build.prompt: Where did you get your shoes?
sentence_build.answer: The shop I visited last month had a sale.

sentence_build.prompt: The workshop yesterday was very informative.
sentence_build.answer: Do you know if there will be another one soon?

sentence_build.prompt: The new restaurant downtown has amazing reviews.
sentence_build.answer: Do you know if they have vegetarian options?

sentence_build.prompt: That was a great movie we watched last night.
sentence_build.answer: Would you like to see another film by that director?

sentence_build.prompt: I’m planning to visit my grandparents next weekend.
sentence_build.answer: Can you tell me whether you need a lift to the airport?

sentence_build.prompt: The book you lent me was fascinating.
sentence_build.answer: Do you know if the author has written other books?

sentence_build.prompt: The new software update looks promising.
sentence_build.answer: On which website were you able to find the download?

sentence_build.prompt: The new coffee shop downtown is very popular.
sentence_build.answer: Is that the one where you can watch football matches on screen?

sentence_build.prompt: We had a great time at the concert last night.
sentence_build.answer: How can we find out when that band is performing again?

sentence_build.prompt: I really enjoyed the hiking trip last weekend.
sentence_build.answer: Can you tell me if there are more trips planned for this month?

discussion.professor_prompt: professor’s question. In your response, you should do the following. Express and support your opinion. Dr. Achebe Next week we’ll be discussing the impact of digital media on traditional forms of communication. Some argue that digital media has had a beneficial effect overall, as it has greatly improved global communication and connectivity. Others believe it has had a largely negative effect, leading to the decline of face-to-face interactions and reduced quality of relationships. What is your opinion on this?

student_posts.name: Student B
student_posts.message: I believe digital media has primarily had a positive effect. It allows people to stay in touch over long distances with friends and family with whom they may not have had much contact otherwise. The convenience and speed of digital media allow people to communicate with ease. Although it seems like a good thing on the surface, I think digital media has led to some serious problems. People often spend more time online than engaging in real-life conversations, which can erode social bonds and reduce the quality of communication with others. We need to find a balance between digital and traditional communication. 34
